#### `def get_pandas_objects(module_name, recurse)` (Línea 494)
- **Propósito:** Get all pandas objects within a module.

An object is determined to be part of pandas if it has a string
__module__ attribute that starts with ``"pandas"``.

Parameters
----------
module_name : str
    Name of the module to search.
recurse : bool
    Whether to search submodules.

Returns
-------
    List of all objects that are determined to be a part of pandas.
- **Firma:** `def get_pandas_objects(module_name, recurse)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
